units.source_text: [\[15\]](#part1335.html#w15) 末摘花即红花，摘下来可做红色染料。

en.t: [15] Safflower is also called suetsumuhana; when picked, it can be made into a red dye.

units.source_text: 花生在茎的末端，故称为末摘花。

en.t: Because the flowers grow at the tips of the stems, it is called suetsumuhana, the flower picked at the end.

units.source_text: 前文说过，这小姐的鼻尖有一点红色，所以把她比作末摘花。

en.t: As mentioned earlier, the young lady had a little redness at the tip of her nose, so she was compared to the safflower.
The title of this chapter is based on this poem.
